`Test UI (3/16)` failed on head 8dd8c259 (run 40542786204, job 122326263181), and the failure is not this PR's.

The red test is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10804.test.tsx:106`: `engine.inspector.flowNode.kind: the zh row must not be the English one: expected 'Node' not to be 'Node'`. This PR changes one file, `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx`, and does not touch that test or what it reads.

Cause (read, not instrumented): #26780 (#25922 slice S2, merged to main after this branch's base, so it is in the CI merge ref) moved `engine.inspector.flowNode.*` into the lazy `studio` i18n namespace. The 10804 test's `zhRow()` calls `t(key, 'zh-CN')` synchronously and has no module-scope `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`, so it reads the en row whenever the zh chunk has not landed yet. It is the same race class this PR fixes, in a file outside this card's claimed surface (studio-design only). Main's `Test UI` was green on 44855365, which fits an intermittent race.

No fix exists yet; the same one-line preload fixes it. I am handing it to the ui seat to carry as its own card rather than widening this PR. One re-run of the failed jobs follows once this run completes.
